title: RepoRoom migration v4 is listed before v2/v3 in wrangler.toml
description:
The migrations array lists v4 ahead of v2 and v3. Cloudflare applies migrations in array order, so a fresh deploy applies them out of sequence.

Small, and exactly the kind of thing that is invisible until a first deploy into a clean account — which is the deploy Phase 5 needs.

From pxc, finding 71cdb339.
acceptance_criteria: wrangler.toml lists migrations in ascending order and a check fails if a new one is inserted out of sequence
